notes.title: Partial Reset Results Are Recorded but Not Enforced Before Arena Reuse
notes.problem: ResetMapService can return a successful result containing skippedChunks when a coverage recovery operation fails. lastResetResultByArena records that result, but no current consumer rejects arena reuse or retries the skipped chunks solely because skippedChunks is non-empty. Current selected-artifact evidence does not prove that the recovery-failure path occurs during normal v1.1.3 gameplay, so this is not promoted to a gameplay BUG.
notes.action: Make reset completion explicit: either retry/resolve every skipped reset chunk before cleanup is considered complete, or surface a hard reset failure that prevents reuse. Consume lastResetResultByArena rather than storing it as diagnostics only.

evidence.finding: processChunksOverTime() records recovery failures in skippedChunks and resolves; lastResetResultByArena stores the result, while waitForArenaCleanup()/startGame() do not inspect skippedChunks.

notes.title: Kit Selection Immediately Reapplies Loadout Without an Explicit Gameplay-Phase Gate
notes.problem: setSelectedKit() persists the kit and immediately calls applySelectedKitNow() without checking whether the arena is in preparation/buy phase or active combat. Current artifact evidence does not prove unintended normal-player selector reachability during combat.
notes.action: Define one kit-change policy. If kit changes are preparation-only, enforce that phase at the KitManager owner rather than relying on physical/UI reachability.

evidence.finding: setSelectedKit() has no GameManager phase check and immediately refreshes loadout.

notes.title: Entity Selection Stick Is Still Active in Production
notes.problem: EntitySelectionLogger subscribes to normal minecraft:stick use and records player coordinates without an explicit PermissionService check.
notes.action: Remove EntitySelectionLogger from release bootstrap or gate the complete tool behind developer permission.

evidence.finding: EntitySelectionLogger itemUse handler accepts minecraft:stick and addSelection() has no permission gate.

notes.title: Several World-Mutating Script Events Do Not Use the Existing Developer Permission Owner
notes.problem: reset_game, force_end, force_start, force_fail and reset_map handlers mutate session/world state without calling PermissionService.canUseDeveloperTools(). skip_level is permission-gated, demonstrating an existing authority owner. Ordinary-player command reachability is not claimed.
notes.action: Route every developer/admin mutation event through the same PermissionService gate.

evidence.finding: handleResetCommand(), handleForceEndCommand(), handleForceStartCommand(), handleForceFailCommand() and ResetMapService script event do not check developer permission; handleSkipLevelCommand() does.

notes.title: Drive Changelog Still Marks v1.1.1 as Current
notes.problem: The selected world and BP/RP manifests are v1.1.3, while the Drive changelog still identifies v1.1.1 as Current.
notes.action: Update the Drive changelog/current marker to v1.1.3 and keep selected-world identity as artifact authority.

evidence.finding: Drive selected world is Defense Challenge v1.1.3.mcworld and both manifests are [1,1,3], while the fetched changelog is stale.
